purpose: Stable research relationship catalog for daily auxiliary market evidence, not a trend signal or official industry routing authority.

role_semantics.core: Industry aggregate used for theme evidence calculations. NOT proof of profitability for every constituent.
role_semantics.related: Watchlist industry only; excluded from core theme scores, ranking, and automatic downstream handoff.

update_policy: Version reviewed mappings when classifications or verifiable industry evidence changes; never rewrite catalog daily from stock movements.
historical_rule: Catalog as-of 2026-10-11. Applying it to an earlier trade date is retrospective smoke only; it must not be presented as strict point-in-time replay.
sources: SW2021 industry classification 2021 Level-2 code semantics; corroborated with repository 2026-10-09 SW L3 industry codes

taxonomy_coverage.classification_basis: SW2021 six-digit L3 code is grouped by first four digits; taxonomy group is not a verified cross-industry investment theme.
taxonomy_coverage.cross_theme_statement: Seventeen separately reviewed investment research themes remain distinct; industry taxonomic group is not trend or profitability confirmation.
